title: 第10章 全款拿下！江先生的爱心宵夜？
slug: 神豪从收留精神小妹开始日进斗金
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“你......”光头房东嘴角猛地一抽。

有种被江辰给摆了一道的感觉。

三十五万的价格，不算低了。

这挂壁公寓他挂在某宝上，售价也就三十二万多。

愣是没人愿意出价。

挂壁公寓，是他名下三套房产其中之一。

地段不算好，租金没法涨，每年的租金收入远不如另外两套。

他早就想卖掉了，买块新地皮，再起东山。

“你要是嫌价格低了，也可以不卖。”江辰学着光头房东方才说话的语气，说道。

光头房东咬了咬牙，生怕江辰反悔，连忙道：“好，就这么定了！三十五万，整栋公寓就转手给你了！”

江辰闻言，嘴角微微一扬。

这老光头，怕不是以为他还有的赚吧？

“小江，啊不，江先生，定金您打算先给多少？”光头房东试探性地问道。

“手续走完后，我直接全款付清。”江辰语气平淡。

像是在说着一件平常小事。

光头房东脸上惊疑不定。

直接全款付清？

这么有实力？

一旁的丸子和香菜，惊得说不出一个字来。

对她们来说，35万绝对是一个天文数字。

但对于江辰来说，似乎只是一个微不足道的数字。

由于光头房东急着出售这栋挂壁公寓，手续很快就办理完了。

“三十五万，秒到账！”

光头房东看着银行发来的到账短信，激动得身体都在颤抖。

看向江辰，一脸谄笑：“江先生，您还真是个爽快人呐！”

“这不，我名下还有几套房子，不知江先生有没有兴趣？”

“没兴趣。”江辰直接一口回绝。

“死光头，既然这房子是江哥名下的了，那你愣着干嘛，赶紧给老娘滚啊。”丸子怒声一喝，越看这光头，越想动手揍他一顿。

“你……”

光头房东的表情，就跟吞了一大口苍蝇似的。

丸子双手抱胸，戏虐道：“难不成，你真想留下来给我们刷马桶？”

闻言，光头房东面色瞬间变得铁青。

但看在江辰的面子上，他也不好当即发作。

冷哼一声，愤然离去。

“哥，亏大了啊！这挂壁公寓，哪里值那么多钱啊！”丸子眼中有些担忧的看向江辰。

香菜也忍不住问道：“哥，你到底在打什么主意？”

面对二女追问，江辰只好发挥小说家的聪明才智，编了一个借口。

“我的一位朋友转了五十万给我，让我务必买下这套挂壁公寓，说是用来搞什么投资。”

丸子想了想，道：“投资？这破公寓难不成以后要搞拆迁？”

江辰耸了耸肩。

“哥，你玩‘农药’不？咱们三个一起刚好可以三排！”

Page (1/3)

"You..." The bald landlord's mouth twitched sharply.

There was a feeling of being tricked by Jiang Chen.

The price of three hundred and fifty thousand is not low.

He hung this wall-mounted apartment on a certain treasure, and the price was only over 320,000.

Surprisingly, no one was willing to bid.

The wall-mounted apartment is one of three properties under his name.

The location is not good, the rent cannot be increased, and the annual rental income is far lower than the other two properties.

He had long wanted to sell it, buy a new piece of land, and start a new business.

"If you think the price is too low, you don't have to sell it." Jiang Chen imitated the tone of the bald landlord and said.

The bald landlord gritted his teeth, fearing that Jiang Chen would regret it, and said quickly: "Okay, it's settled! For 350,000, the entire apartment will be transferred to you!"

When Jiang Chen heard this, the corner of his mouth raised slightly.

This old bald man probably thinks he can still make some money, right?

"Xiao Jiang, ah no, Mr. Jiang, how much deposit do you plan to give first?" the bald landlord asked tentatively.

"After the formalities are completed, I will pay the full amount directly." Jiang Chen said calmly.

It's like talking about an ordinary thing.

The bald landlord had a look of surprise on his face.

Pay in full directly?

So powerful?

The meatballs and coriander on the side were so shocked that they couldn't say a word.

For them, 350,000 is absolutely an astronomical number.

But to Jiang Chen, it seemed to be just an insignificant number.

Since the bald landlord was eager to sell the wall-mounted apartment, the procedures were completed quickly.

"Three hundred and fifty thousand, received in seconds!"

The bald landlord looked at the bank arrival text message and was so excited that his body was shaking.

He looked at Jiang Chen with a flattering smile: "Mr. Jiang, you are really a cheerful person!"

"No, I still have a few houses under my name. I wonder if Mr. Jiang is interested?"

"Not interested." Jiang Chen refused directly.

"Damn bald head, since this house is under Brother Jiang's name, why are you standing there? Get out of here." Wanzi shouted angrily. The more he looked at the bald head, the more he wanted to beat him up.

"You..."

The expression on the bald landlord's face was as if he had swallowed a big mouthful of flies.

Wanzi crossed his arms and said teasingly: "Is it possible that you really want to stay and clean our toilet?"

Hearing this, the bald landlord's complexion instantly turned livid.

But for Jiang Chen's sake, he didn't want to attack immediately.

He snorted coldly and left angrily.

"Brother, what a big loss! This wall-mounted apartment is not worth so much money!" Wanzi looked at Jiang Chen with some worry in his eyes.

Xiangcai couldn't help but ask: "Brother, what are you planning?"

Faced with the two women's questioning, Jiang Chen had no choice but to use his cleverness as a novelist and make up an excuse.

"A friend of mine transferred half a million to me and told me to buy this wall-mounted apartment, saying it would be used for some investment."

Wanzi thought for a while and said: "Investment? Is it possible that this shabby apartment will be demolished in the future?"

Jiang Chen shrugged.

"Brother, do you want to play 'Pesticide'? The three of us can just sit in three rows together!"
